<ParamField body="animated" type="boolean" default="true">
  Animate the highlight by default. Reduced-motion preferences always disable animation.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="aria-hidden" type="Booleanish">
  Placeholders are decorative and hidden from assistive technology by default. The host owns loading announcements.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="baseColor" type="BackgroundColor">
  Placeholder background color. Defaults to #ebebeb. Pass a theme background token for themed placeholders.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="borderRadius" type="BorderRadius&lt;string | number&gt;">
  Corner radius in pixels or a CSS length. Defaults to 0.25rem and inherits the surrounding corner shape.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="className" type="string">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="containerClassName" type="string">
  CSS class applied to the wrapper in line layout.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="count" type="number" default="1">
  Number of placeholders in line layout. Defaults to one.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="height" type="Height&lt;string | number&gt;">
  Placeholder height in pixels or a CSS length. Defaults to the inherited font height.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="highlightColor" type="BackgroundColor">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="layout" type="&quot;line&quot; | &quot;shape&quot;" default="shape">
